The two R1 dispositions are independently closed:

| R1 finding | Disposition and evidence |
| --- | --- |
| **ASTRA-S2-R1-01, P2:** obsolete central save failure survived a successful retry | **CLOSED.** `src/ui/notices.ts:30–39` clears only an existing persistence-channel central notice when a non-error persistence notification arrives. Export/graphics success remains system-channel feedback and cannot establish local recovery (`src/runtime/app.ts:521–550`); Session labels success only after the guarded local commit (`src/runtime/session.ts:309–333`). The old failure timeout is removed through the normal notice renderer, not left to erase a newer result. A composed independent Session/Repository/GameView quota probe retained the journal, exportable state, paused focus and panel, then retained the old current generation verbatim as previous on recovery. The chip expired without replay; an unrelated system error, ongoing hazard and detached call survived successful local feedback as applicable. Reset/dispose removed timers. Current cancellation/disposal tests also pass. The final native-rAF browser trace separately proves failure → export → retry at tick 14454, recovery 264.8 ms after the preceding failure/export observation, and chip-expiry observation 3428.6 ms later, with recovered state equal to the actual export. These are UI-lifetime checks, not a claim of prior save corruption. |
| **SOL-S2-R1-1, P2:** closed-panel departure/return retained the previous storage intent | **CLOSED.** `src/ui/panels.ts:63–69` observes the existing stable anchor and resets only transient From/explicit To/fallback copy when it changes. Both refresh and `GameView.update` call it (`src/ui/view.ts:371–374`); anchor rules remain at `src/ui/panels.ts:194–209`. Independent probes over the final earned workshop/away/return states confirmed same-site choice continuity and departure reset, with no panel render, focus/scroll change, timer, submitted command or expedition mutation during closed-panel observations. Inaccessible-choice fallback remains explicit (`src/ui/panels.ts:303–320`). The final trace shows field departure at tick 13385 and workshop return at 14398, panels closed throughout, unchanged panel mutation count/scroll and exact inventory; reopening selects Workshop locker and Diver → Workshop. No transfer was submitted. This closes an intent/UI defect, not inventory corruption. |

Evidence limits are material to this acceptance. I launched no reviewer browser, server or recording; I used original imagery/traces, current compiled probes and the complete check. Both required browser-rule files were read. The final correction evidence uses native rAF, synthetic movement keys and native menu/F5 on unchanged earned imports. Earlier composed HUD movement uses synthetic keys with a controlled four-tick rAF schedule. It reaches production handlers without grants/relocation, but does not establish real-time human pacing or physical-mouse comfort. One earlier root captured-look change was unrecorded, so there is no exact per-tick look replay. The final danger trace's exploratory import/settings/look attempts remain disclosed in tooling notes.

The refit is a short cradle service/departure/return/exit/remove/reinstall/reboard/next-outing, not fresh progression. Seeded storage, body/air, obstruction, carrier and occlusion diagnostics are not ordinary earned progression. Some CSS-960 images are normalized to 1280-pixel PNGs; viewport metadata owns their layout size. Motion sheets were inspected; I did not claim fresh video playback or audible mix from them. Muted SwiftShader evidence does not establish consumer-GPU performance, audio mix, enjoyment, duration or full-game completion. None of these boundaries is used to defer a concrete observed blocker; no such blocker remains in this review.
